verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 5.103
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 5.103

verses.pali: 11. Phāsuvihāravagga
verses.english: 11. Living Comfortably

verses.pali: Mahācorasutta
verses.english: A Master Thief

verses.pali: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato mahācoro sandhimpi chindati, nillopampi harati, ekāgārikampi karoti, paripanthepi tiṭṭhati.
verses.english: “Mendicants, a master thief with five factors breaks into houses, plunders wealth, steals from isolated buildings, and commits highway robbery.

verses.pali: Katamehi pañcahi?
verses.english: What five?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro visamanissito ca hoti, gahananissito ca, balavanissito ca, bhogacāgī ca, ekacārī ca.
verses.english: A master thief relies on rough ground, on thick cover, and on the powerful; they pay bribes, and they act alone.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, mahācoro visamanissito hoti?
verses.english: And how does a master thief rely on rough ground?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro nadīviduggaṁ vā nissito hoti pabbatavisamaṁ vā.
verses.english: It’s when a master thief relies on inaccessible riverlands or rugged mountains.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, mahācoro visamanissito hoti.
verses.english: That’s how a master thief relies on rough ground.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, mahācoro gahananissito hoti?
verses.english: And how does a master thief rely on thick cover?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro tiṇagahanaṁ vā nissito hoti rukkhagahanaṁ vā rodhaṁ vā mahāvanasaṇḍaṁ vā.
verses.english: It’s when a master thief relies on thick grass, thick trees, a blind spot, or a large forest grove.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, mahācoro gahananissito hoti.
verses.english: That’s how a master thief relies on thick cover.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, mahācoro balavanissito hoti?
verses.english: And how does a master thief rely on the powerful?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro rājānaṁ vā rājamahāmattānaṁ vā nissito hoti.
verses.english: It’s when a master thief relies on rulers or their chief ministers.

verses.pali: Tassa evaṁ hoti:
verses.english: They think:

verses.pali: ‘sace maṁ koci kiñci vakkhati, ime me rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā pariyodhāya atthaṁ bhaṇissantī’ti.
verses.english: ‘If anyone accuses me of anything, these rulers or their chief ministers will speak in my defense in the case.’

verses.pali: Sace naṁ koci kiñci āha, tyassa rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā pariyodhāya atthaṁ bhaṇanti.
verses.english: And that’s exactly what happens.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, mahācoro balavanissito hoti.
verses.english: That’s how a master thief relies on the powerful.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, mahācoro bhogacāgī hoti?
verses.english: And how does a master thief pay bribes?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro aḍḍho hoti mahaddhano mahābhogo.
verses.english: It’s when a master thief is rich, affluent, and wealthy.

verses.pali: Tassa evaṁ hoti:
verses.english: They think:

verses.pali: ‘sace maṁ koci kiñci vakkhati, ito bhogena paṭisantharissāmī’ti.
verses.english: ‘If anyone accuses me of anything, I’ll settle it with a bribe.’

verses.pali: Sace naṁ koci kiñci āha, tato bhogena paṭisantharati.
verses.english: And that’s exactly what happens.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, mahācoro bhogacāgī hoti.
verses.english: That’s how a master thief pays bribes.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, mahācoro ekacārī hoti?
verses.english: And how does a master thief act alone?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro ekakova gahaṇāni kattā hoti.
verses.english: It’s when a master thief carries out robbery all alone.

verses.pali: Taṁ kissa hetu?
verses.english: Why is that?

verses.pali: ‘Mā me guyhamantā bahiddhā sambhedaṁ agamaṁsū’ti.
verses.english: So that their secret plans are not leaked to others.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, mahācoro ekacārī hoti.
verses.english: That’s how a master thief acts alone.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahaṅgehi samannāgato mahācoro sandhimpi chindati nillopampi harati ekāgārikampi karoti paripanthepi tiṭṭhati.
verses.english: A master thief with these five factors breaks into houses, plunders wealth, steals from isolated buildings, and commits highway robbery.

verses.pali: Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato pāpabhikkhu khataṁ upahataṁ attānaṁ pariharati, sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo viññūnaṁ, bahuñca apuññaṁ pasavati.
verses.english: In the same way, when a bad mendicant has five qualities, they keep themselves broken and damaged. They deserve to be blamed and criticized by sensible people, and they brim with much wickedness.

verses.pali: Katamehi pañcahi?
verses.english: What five?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu visamanissito ca hoti, gahananissito ca, balavanissito ca, bhogacāgī ca, ekacārī ca.
verses.english: A bad mendicant relies on rough ground, on thick cover, and on the powerful; they pay bribes, and they act alone.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu visamanissito hoti?
verses.english: And how does a bad mendicant rely on rough ground?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu visamena kāyakammena samannāgato hoti, visamena vacīkammena samannāgato hoti, visamena manokammena samannāgato hoti.
verses.english: It’s when a bad mendicant has unethical conduct by way of body, speech, and mind.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu visamanissito hoti.
verses.english: That’s how a bad mendicant relies on rough ground.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu gahananissito hoti?
verses.english: And how does a bad mendicant rely on thick cover?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu micchādiṭṭhiko hoti antaggāhikāya diṭṭhiyā samannāgato.
verses.english: It’s when a bad mendicant has wrong view, he’s attached to an extremist view.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu gahananissito hoti.
verses.english: That’s how a bad mendicant relies on thick cover.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu balavanissito hoti?
verses.english: And how does a bad mendicant rely on the powerful?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu rājānaṁ vā rājamahāmattānaṁ vā nissito hoti.
verses.english: It’s when a bad mendicant relies on rulers or their chief ministers.

verses.pali: Tassa evaṁ hoti:
verses.english: They think:

verses.pali: ‘sace maṁ koci kiñci vakkhati, ime me rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā pariyodhāya atthaṁ bhaṇissantī’ti.
verses.english: ‘If anyone accuses me of anything, these rulers or their chief ministers will speak in my defense in the case.’

verses.pali: Sace naṁ koci kiñci āha, tyassa rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā pariyodhāya atthaṁ bhaṇanti.
verses.english: And that’s exactly what happens.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu balavanissito hoti.
verses.english: That’s how a bad mendicant relies on the powerful.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu bhogacāgī hoti?
verses.english: And how does a bad mendicant pay bribes?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu lābhī hoti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānappaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṁ.
verses.english: It’s when a bad mendicant receives robes, almsfood, lodgings, and medicines and supplies for the sick.

verses.pali: Tassa evaṁ hoti:
verses.english: They think:

verses.pali: ‘sace maṁ koci kiñci vakkhati, ito lābhena paṭisantharissāmī’ti.
verses.english: ‘If anyone accuses me of anything, I’ll settle it with a bribe.’

verses.pali: Sace naṁ koci kiñci āha, tato lābhena paṭisantharati.
verses.english: And that’s exactly what happens.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu bhogacāgī hoti.
verses.english: That’s how a bad mendicant pays bribes.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu ekacārī hoti?
verses.english: And how does a bad mendicant act alone?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu ekakova paccantimesu janapadesu nivāsaṁ kappeti.
verses.english: It’s when a bad mendicant dwells alone in the borderlands.

verses.pali: So tattha kulāni upasaṅkamanto lābhaṁ labhati.
verses.english: They visit families there to acquire material things.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu ekacārī hoti.
verses.english: That’s how a bad mendicant acts alone.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato pāpabhikkhu khataṁ upahataṁ attānaṁ pariharati, sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo viññūnaṁ, bahuñca apuññaṁ pasavatī”ti.
verses.english: When a bad mendicant possesses these five qualities, they keep themselves broken and damaged. They deserve to be blamed and criticized by sensible people, and they create much wickedness.”

verses.pali: Tatiyaṁ.
